official_title: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts – Presidency third compromise text (Articles 1–29, Annexes I–IV)
version_label: Third Presidency compromise, Articles 1–29 and Annexes I–IV, REV 1

institution_roles.evidence_locator: PDF p. 1 From Presidency to Delegations; introduction paragraphs 5-7 attribute substantive preparation to the Czech Presidency. The Council association represents the Presidency acting within the Council, without implying Council adoption.

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Published first part of the third Council Presidency compromise.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: The Czech Presidency, acting within the Council, is the substantive drafter and originator, and Delegations are the recipient. The Council author association represents that Presidency origin and does not imply Council adoption. This exact REV 1 is distinct from INIT, identifies changes against ST 11124/22 and is paired with ST 12549/22 for the remaining provisions. The issue date remains 16 September 2022. Annex 6 of ST 15322/24 documents later disclosure on 28 October 2024, not first-ever publication. The separate register rows support the REV 1-to-INIT version edge without resolving the held INIT manifestation conflict.

publication_date.meaning: The Council reply establishes documented later disclosure/public access on 2024-10-28, not first-ever publication.
